RR21BB_SPEC01.description: Storm is a truly intrepid interpretation of Black Badge Ghost, a striking two tone exterior is complemented by a bold Turchese and Black interior.
RR21BB_SPEC03.description: Unleash a new beginning with Ascend; a truly daring Phoenix Red leather is concealed within the signature Black exterior and complemented perfectly by Black Badge red brake calipers.
RR21BB_SPEC04.description: Unapologetic is style, Flame offers an iconic Black Badge aesthetic with Black exterior and Black and Forge Yellow interior.
RR21BB_SPEC05.description: Glow showcases a daring combination of Black and Mandarin combined to produce a truly head turning specification. Enhanced by the addition of colour matched mandarin brake calipers.
RR21BB_SPEC06.description: A classic but bold combination of Arctic White and Black are brought to life through Quartz. Mirrored on the interior featuring a pop of dynamic red from the brake calipers.
RR21BB_SPEC07.description: Nebula offers a vibrant and seductive interpretation of Black Badge Ghost, the Magma Red exterior is complemented by the Black and Phoenix Red interior.
RR21BB_SPEC08.description: For the King or Queen of the night, Twilight offers a stylish take on Black Badge Ghost.
RR21BB_SPEC09.description: Nightfall is for those who dare to break convention, the striking Burnout Grey exterior enhances the dynamic presence whilst the Black and Tailored Purple interior add an elegant edge.
RR21BB_SPEC10.description: A mesmerising exterior of Galileo Blue is complemented by a light and bold interior of Grace White and Forge Yellow, for those looking for a truly unique representation of Black Badge.
RR21BB_SPEC11.description: Infinity, a striking expression of individuality. The distinctive Black and Grace White interior is contrasted with a bold Crystal over Fame Green exterior.
RR21BB_SPEC12.description: A radiant exterior of Crystal over Orange Metallic is perfectly complemented by a Black and Cashmere Grey interior. Solstice truly is an enchanting rendition of Ghost Black Badge.

RR11_SPEC01.description: Dynamism is the bold embodiment of an unwavering confidence. The Black Diamond over Monteverde two-tone application adds a restless and rebellious expression to the spirit that is Phantom. This spirit and ceaseless quest for excellence is woven into every fibre of Phantom. Peony Pink on the coachline and in the interior, alongside the captivating Ruthenium Bloom Gallery, further enhance this.
RR11_SPEC02.description: By combining a Tempest Grey exterior with Dynamic 7 Spoke Part Polished wheels, Cipher is truly a contemporary expression of Phantom's character. This duality is also present throughout the interior through a combination of the sleek Piano White Veneer and the intricate Cascade Steel Gallery.
RR11_SPEC03.description: The enigmatic Tempest Grey over Gunmetal two-tone application is connected to the Scivaro Grey and Forge Yellow interior.  The expertly crafted Ruthenium Bloom Gallery is made from two layers of laser cut Stainless Steel coated in Ruthenium, one polished and one brushed. Black Painted Disc Wheels further exemplify the rebellious nature of Enigma.
RR11_SPEC04.description: The energising Iguazu Blue exterior is harmoniously combined with a Black Iced Bonnet and Exterior Black Detailing, ensuring a sense of presence. This theme connects to the exquisite Dark Amber veneer and Rivenslate Gallery on the interior.
RR11_SPEC05.description: Dusk is striking in appearance with dark exterior detailing and the Spirit of Ecstasy crafted in Carbon Fibre. This darker character is contrasted by a Grace White interior with Mandarin accents, ensuring balance within.
RR11_SPEC06.description: A striking expression of modern elegance, where Crystal over Orange Metallic captures the warmth of a setting sun, accentuated by a Grace White coachline and a radiant Mandarin interior, Sundown is an exquisite example of light, colour and craftsmanship through every detail.
RR12_SPEC01.description: An Olivin exterior in combination with the Fully Polished Disc Wheels show the elegance of Phantom Extended. This elegance extends into the Grace White and Iceland Moss interior. Finely crafted Dark Amber veneer is included, ensuring serenity greets the occupants.
RR12_SPEC02.description: Unrivalled in its ability to be a sanctuary for its occupants, the refined interior environment offers serenity in a subtle, yet sophisticated form. The Cascade Steel Gallery creates an incomparable aura, complimented by the Crystal over Arctic White exterior.
RR12_SPEC03.description: Serene shows the breadth of Phantom Extended with its soothing Tungsten exterior and Grace White coachline, encapsulating the heritage of earlier Phantom through a contemporary medium. Tan is continued into the interior, where it provides a warmth that is enhanced by an Oak Cluster veneer.
RR12_SPEC04.description: A Dark Emerald exterior in combination with Dynamic wheels showcases the ethos of Phantom Extended. Stainless Steel Pinstripes are applied to the High Gloss Royal Walnut Veneer on the interior. This innovation through craftsmanship is complimented by the intricate Ruthenium Bloom Gallery, excellently tying together the wide range of metallic finishes.
RR12_SPEC05.description: A Tempest Grey over Bohemian Red two-tone exterior is symbolic of the allure in Phantom Extended. This allure is enhanced through the mesmerising Cascade Ruthenium Gallery and the intricately crafted Open Pore Obsidian Ayous Canadel Panelling.

RR25_LRW_SPEC01.description: This Inspired Specification takes inspiration from the spiritual significance of Spring. A season of new beginnings and vitality, re-awakening the mind and the environment. Absolute serene reverie.
RR25_LRW_SPEC02.description: Blooming in the Spring season, the cherry blossom is a symbolic flower of renewal and new beginnings. Embodying the ephemeral beauty of nature.
RR25_LRW_SPEC03.description: This Inspired Specification is inspired by the unruly beauty of Spring perennial wildflowers. Embellishing woodland with vibrancy and excitement, the perennial spring wildflowers embody the free spirit.

RR25_SPEC08.description: Showcasing a Twilight Purple exterior with a Silver Satin Bonnet and Silver Shoulder Coachline, and an Arctic White, Tailored Purple and Black interior.

Vigour.description: Vigour embodies the powerful mystique of Black Badge. Exquisite Salamanca Blue paint is complemented by a bold Arctic White and Black interior, completed with Mandarin detailing.
Tenacity.description: Combining avant-garde craftsmanship with a daring aesthetic, Rolls-Royce presents Tenacity. A defining Gunmetal exterior is embellished by a Tan and Dark Spice interior colourway to provide a subtle yet distinct expression of luxury.
Allure.description: Allure features a divine Twilight Purple exterior, combined with Graphite two-tone paint to accentuate Wraith's architectural elegance. Seashell leather then provides a bold contrast, completed with intricate Tailored Purple embroidery.
Vitality.description: The enchanting aura of Black Badge is embodied by Vitality, with a crisp, Arctic White exterior embellished by contemporary black detailing. Wraith's interior then consists of a divine, Black contrast, completing an enigmatic yet elegant sanctuary.
Reverance.description: A tenacious incarnation of elegance, Reverance features an exquisite Black Diamond paint, personifying the menacing nature of Black Badge. A vibrant contrast is then achieved with Charles Blue interior colourways, providing a striking aesthetic to Wraith.
Menace.description: With an Iced Gunmetal exterior, Menace provides a cool, modern, dynamic edge to Black Badge Wraith. A tenacious Mugello Red and Black interior is complemented by Selby Grey detailing, effectively breaking up visual mass.
Potent.description: Potent in nature, this exemplifies the irreproachable quality of Rolls-Royce. Jewel-like Midnight Sapphire paint is complemented by a prominent Selby Grey interior, finished with intricate Navy Blue detailing.
Fortitude.description: With a definitive fusion of Gunmetal and Silver exterior paints, Fortitude represents a truly authentic Rolls-Royce creation. The luxury interior comprised of Seashell and Black leather is complemented by the cool and contemporary metal fascia.
Polar Crown.description: The epitome of unparalleled elegance features a crisp Arctic White exterior, with Black detailing and wheels to break up visual mass. The combined Arctic White and Navy Blue interior is completed with Smoked Chestnut Veneer, exhibiting sophistication.
Onyx.description: Inspired by the beauty of an intriguing mineral, Onyx showcases the avant-garde craftsmanship of Rolls-Royce. Black and Driftwood interior leathers complement the Black Stained Ash veneer, whilst the Mandarin detailing matches its iconic Rolls-Royce coachline.
Apex.description: With a striking Salamanca Blue paint, Apex encompasses both a contemporary and distinct expression of luxury for its occupants. Anthracite Grey wheels are synonymous with the Selby Grey interior, adorned with ravishing Cobalto Blue detailing.
Domus.description: Stylish Crystal over Selby Grey paint characterises Domus as an iconic embodiment of elegance. A subtle Black and Selby Grey interior is matched with a Tudor Oak veneer, illuminated beneath the Rolls-Royce's Shooting Star Headliner.
RR21_SPEC01.description: A monochromatic interpretation of Essence, reflecting the Purity of Ghost. Finished in Arctic White paint and Arctic White leather, a touch of colour is added through Tailored Purple contrast stitching, harmonising with Essence.
RR21_SPEC02.description: The essence of Ghost;  a contemporary, self-assured specification which combines the modernity of Tempest Grey with detoxifying Grace White leather, subtly accented with Tailored Purple.
RR21_SPEC03.description: Solent is a dynamic embodiment of nature's charm. The prominent yet serene Wittering Blue exterior reflects the unmistakable elegance of Ghost. This is complimented by a Seashell interior, contrasting the coast with the rich shade of the Ocean.
RR21_SPEC04.description: Optic enchants with its combination of the iconic exterior finish, Salamanca Blue, combined with refreshing Cashmere Grey. The interior harmonises with the exterior through subtle applications of Cobalto Blue.
RR21_SPEC05.description: An agile interpretation, Spirit harnesses Ghost's athletic characteristics, combining Arctic White and Black on the interior with Forge Yellow. The exterior include the 21'' Part Polished Shadow Wheels.
RR21_SPEC06.description: Reflection's immersive Charles Blue interior reflects the character of a still, clear lake, the gunmetal exterior celebrates the rocky façade that surround some of the world’s most iconic bodies of water.
RR21_SPEC07.description: Eminence an elevation of stature. An elegant Premiere Silver exterior is combined with a commanding and bold Tan and Navy interior that exemplifies the unmatched elegance of this authentic creation.
RR22_SPEC01.description: Shadow represents the versatility of Ghost. Its subtle Dark Emerald and Diamond Black two-tone is enhanced by a Mandarin single coachline. The interior provides an environment for business, relaxing of socialising by combining Grace White and Black with small details of Mandarin stitching.
RR22_SPEC02.description: A modern interpretation of a classic theme, Aura epitomises the unparalleled elegance of Ghost. A divine Midnight Sapphire exterior enhances its sculptural grace, whilst Navy and Charles Blue leather compliment the crisp Artic White interior.
RR22_SPEC03.description: Mirage showcases the powerful mystique of Ghost, a deep Bohemian Red exterior is combined with subtle tones of Cashmere Grey and Black. The interior includes Ardent Red detailing, harmonising with the exterior.
RR22_SPEC04.description: The Dark Indigo Exterior intrigues with a tone that evolves with the elements. The Arctic White interior provides a refined space, elevated by the slate the subtle tones of Scivaro Grey and Tailored Purple.
RR22_SPEC05.description: Solar is inspired by sun flare. Its bold Lyrical Copper exterior reveals more than what you see when the sun shines, it's interior incorporate a new veneer to the Rolls-Royce palette, Dark Amber, which harmonises with the Havana and Mandarin leather.
RR22_SPEC06.description: Virtue is created with the contemporary exterior of Tempest Grey. This is combined with a cool and contemporary interior using Grace White and Havana in a simple and refined interior.
